column1: # THE PROFIT DECLINE ROWS (2026-10-19): the record's own reading of `profitDeclineOf` / `profit_decline_of`
# on FRED's corporate profits after tax (CPATAX, quarterly, seasonally adjusted annual rate, public domain),
# 1947Q1-2026Q2: the fundamental's declines of 10% or more from a running peak to the trough before the
# peak is regained, how many a century, their median and upper-quartile size as a share of the peak, and
# the median months from peak to trough and from trough to regain. One ruler for both sets. Eleven
# declines; the largest 30.2% (2006-2008): the index's own earnings fall further at the tail (write-offs,
# 54% in 2001 and 92% in 2008 on the S&P's trailing earnings), which the disaster channel stands for.
# byte-identical), the FRED file as downloaded 2026-10-19 (observation_date,CPATAX).
